descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S17 「交接页生成过程中病人列表变了，两个模式：没有病人丢失、重复或被带过来」 The patient list changes while the sheet is generating, both contexts: no patient lost, duplicated or carried over

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 From the home screen, one tap on 'Handoff' generates summaries for the physician's patients in one action, not one patient at a time.（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U7 Sections populate only from stored data: an empty section stays empty (no discharge barrier invented when no discharge task exists, no invented pending result), and nothing in the handoff is invented …（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 5；UAT 3.4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U3 Hospital and Nursing Home use the same handoff structure and delivery; there is no separate Nursing Home format (and no data from the other context).（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 3；UAT 3.3；UAT TC-21） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Four Hospital patients, and four Nursing Home residents In Today; the sheet is open and still generating

When From another session the runner adds a fifth Hospital patient and deletes the second; in Nursing Home it takes the second resident out of In Today and adds a fifth In Today; wait for generation to finish

Then Hospital lists M1, M3, M4 and the new M5, each once with their own data, and M2 is gone; Nursing Home lists R1, R3, R4 and R5, each once, and R2 is gone

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: the remaining names present, the removed one absent, no 'Generating', the count line, and each card header ('Room 2B-01 ·', 'Unit Elm 1 ·' …) exactly once (mustAppearOnce; names can repeat inside AI text, card headers do not)

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S17 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-08.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
